capabilities: Add configurable backward/forward skip buttons (1-60s) to embedded audio and video players
Temporarily boost playback speed while a button is held, restoring the prior rate on release
Offer a custom speed menu (0.25x-4.0x) with a persistent current-rate badge
Optionally sync the playback rate across all open media and auto-play the next audio in a note
Expose four commands with user-bound hotkeys and a minimum-duration filter for short clips
extras: README is written in Chinese with an English-language link; the full usage guide, changelog, and issue tracker are external docs. Compatible with Obsidian 1.5.0+ on desktop and mobile; MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: 在 Obsidian 原生 HTML5 音频/视频播放器上叠加极简的增强工具栏
problem: Obsidian's built-in HTML5 audio and video players offer no skip controls, no hold-to-speed, and a fixed speed menu, so adjusting playback while listening is slow.
summary: Overlay toolbar for Obsidian's native audio and video players that adds skip buttons, hold-to-speed, and a customizable playback-rate menu.
